description:
After a claim is registered, it is examined by a claims officer.
The claims officer then writes a settlement recommendation.
This recommendation is then checked by a senior claims officer who may mark the claim as OK or Not OK.
If the claim is marked as Not OK, it is sent back to the claims officer and the recommendation is repeated.
If the claim is OK, the claim handling process proceeds.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" targetNamespace="http://example.com/claims">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_ClaimHandling" name="Claim handling" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_ClaimHandling">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_ClaimsOfficer" name="Claims officer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_ClaimRegistered</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ExamineClaim</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RecommendationMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_WriteRecommendation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_SeniorClaimsOfficer" name="Senior claims officer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckRecommendation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ClaimStatus</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_ClaimRegistered" name="Claim registered">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ClaimRegistered_Examine</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ExamineClaim" name="Examine claim">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ClaimRegistered_Examine</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Examine_RecommendationMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RecommendationMerge" name="Continue recommendation" gatewayDirection="Converging">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Examine_RecommendationMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotOK_ReturnToRecommendation</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RecommendationMerge_Write</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_WriteRecommendation" name="Write settlement recommendation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RecommendationMerge_Write</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Write_Check</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckRecommendation" name="Check recommendation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Write_Check</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Check_ClaimStatus</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ClaimStatus" name="Claim marked OK?" gatewayDirection="Diverging">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Check_ClaimStatus</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OK_Proceed</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotOK_ReturnToRecommendation</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ClaimHandlingProceeds" name="Claim handling proceeds">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OK_Proceed</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ClaimRegistered_Examine" sourceRef="StartEvent_ClaimRegistered" targetRef="Task_ExamineClaim"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Examine_RecommendationMerge" sourceRef="Task_ExamineClaim" targetRef="Gateway_RecommendationMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RecommendationMerge_Write" sourceRef="Gateway_RecommendationMerge" targetRef="Task_WriteRecommendation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Write_Check" sourceRef="Task_WriteRecommendation" targetRef="Task_CheckRecommendation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Check_ClaimStatus" sourceRef="Task_CheckRecommendation" targetRef="Gateway_ClaimStatus"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OK_Proceed" name="OK" sourceRef="Gateway_ClaimStatus" targetRef="EndEvent_ClaimHandlingProceeds">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">claimStatus = 'OK'</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotOK_ReturnToRecommendation" name="Not OK — return to claims officer" sourceRef="Gateway_ClaimStatus" targetRef="Gateway_RecommendationMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">claimStatus = 'Not OK'</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
  </bpmn:process>
